bullets.text: A youth died after his bike fell into an unbarricaded stormwater drain pit near Ambattur, and the office should inspect drainage safety measures.
An engineering student was arrested near Periyapalayam in Tiruvallur for attempting to set a woman ablaze over a rejected love proposal.
Public money reportedly bought AI-generated books for Tamil Nadu libraries, and the department must review purchase records to purge bogus books.

reports.title: Man dies after falling into deep pit dug for construction of canal in Nolambur

takeaways: A young motorist died after his bike plunged into an unmarked stormwater drain excavation near Ambattur.
The local administration faces intense scrutiny over severe safety lapses and lack of warning signs at the site.

stories.title: Engineering college student arrested for attempting to set woman student ablaze over rejected love proposal
takeaways: A 21-year-old engineering student was arrested for attempting to set a female student on fire in Thiruvallur district.
Police have taken swift action following the rejected marriage proposal and assault near Periyapalayam.

stories.title: Publish buying record to purge bogus books from libraries
takeaways: Public libraries across Tamil Nadu are purging reference shelves of books allegedly authored using artificial intelligence tools.
Critics and cultural commentators demand full disclosure of purchasing records to eliminate unverified fiction from educational repositories.
